instruction.text: Holly asked her classmates which languages they can speak and made a pictogram with their answers. Answer the questions using the pictogram.

atoms.a: How many of Holly’s classmates speak English?
How many of Holly’s classmates speak French?
How many of Holly’s classmates speak Spanish?
Do more of Holly’s classmates speak French or Spanish?
How many more of Holly’s classmates speak French than Spanish?

instruction.text: Holly also asks the pupils in her year what their favourite subject is at school. She made a pictogram with their answers. Answer the questions using the pictogram.

atoms.a: How many pupils chose English as their favourite subject?
How many pupils chose Maths as their favourite subject?
How many pupils chose Science as their favourite subject?
How many more pupils prefer Science to Maths?
How many pupils did Holly ask altogether?
